vibe.verdict: A sharp black, white and red club menu that fits the film, with only a note that should be a note and a stray hidden character.
missing: Dalmatian puppies Perdita and Pongo (the ending)
The garbage truck entrance in a newspaper bodice (the Baroness's event)
The moth cocoon dress that wrecks the collection (the spring show)
The Panther De Ville car and the 'de Vil' name
Hell Hall, the manor Cruella takes over
'I was born brilliant. Born bad. And a little bit mad.' (the opening)
ideas: Swap the 'Black and white cake' note for 'I was born brilliant. Born bad. And a little bit mad.'
Swap 'Punk London pub chips' for 'Moth cocoon macarons', note 'The Baroness's collection never saw the show.'
Add 'Panther De Ville, parked out front' to the footer in place of the 'Cover charge after nine' joke.
Swap 'Wink's spotted whipped feta crostini' into the printed menu, in place of the fry-up note.
